task.ques: Determine the area of a regular hexagon with a side length of 7 cm.

claude.final_answer: FINAL: The area of a regular hexagon with side length 7 cm is 147√3/2 cm² ≈ 127.306 cm². WolframAlpha confirms “regular hexagon | edge length 7 cm” and displays this area: https://www.wolframalpha.com/input?i=area+of+regular+hexagon+side+length+7+cm. Evidence: final.png.
